messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-02-24] standup/dune/2026-02-24: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2026-03-09] standup/dune/2026-03-09: Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2026-03-13] standup/boreal/2026-03-13: Deploy freeze for the ledger: 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 (the fiscal year close).
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-18] standup/boreal/2026-03-18: Reminder that the product catalog depends on the resizer.
- [2026-03-20] standup/dune/2026-03-20: Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-04-09] standup/dune/2026-04-09: Reminder from the Dune team: page Farah for anything this cycle, not Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2: Atlas saw that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2026-04-21] handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags: The feature flag service has a new home: the Atlas team. The Dune team kept it until today.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-04-29] standup/ember/2026-04-29: Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the marketing send, the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Team Boreal has switched to a weekly dependency update day.
- [2026-05-05] standup/boreal/2026-05-05: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.
- [2026-05-13] standup/ember/2026-05-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.
- [2026-05-22] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2026-06-03] standup/dune/2026-06-03: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2026-06-08] standup/atlas/2026-06-08: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Marcus.
- [2026-06-17] standup/ember/2026-06-17: Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego Alvarez today.
